sloka: गदानां मुसलानां च परिघाणां च निस्वनैः ।शराणां पुङ्खपातैश्च क्षुभिताः सप्त सागराः ।। ६.११०.१७ ।।
transliteration: gadānāṁ musalānāṁ ca parighāṇāṁ ca nisvanaiḥ ।śarāṇāṁ puṅkhapātaiśca kṣubhitāḥ sapta sāgarāḥ ।। 6.110.17 ।।

translations.english: Once again ensued a tumultuous war fought with maces, mallets, and iron bars, caused hair to stand and the resound of the speed of weapons caused agitation in the seven seas.
